description: Phase 2 Track A — the UX + security follow-ons to the owner-only speaker recognition work shipped in Phase 1 + Phase 2 Track B. Four stories total. A0 (gallery growth) is already shipped — speaker_processor.py:467-480 calls register_session_ref on every successful owner match and append_reference on high-confidence single-turn matches, so the gallery self-adapts within and across sessions. The four remaining stories cover (A1) context redaction — the decider prompt's recent_transcripts block currently renders non-owner transcripts as-is, leaking stranger content into the decider's view. A1 closes that gap by having the context builder redact non-owner rows when speaker_id_enabled. (A2) speakers CLI — add `heare speakers list|info|rm|rename` subcommands on top of the existing enroll-owner so operators can introspect and groom the gallery. (A3) drift audit — `heare speakers audit [<id>]` computing per-speaker cosine drift statistics against centroid and enrollment ref so operators can detect when a gallery has gone stale. (A4) auto-enrollment — an in-memory candidate buffer on SpeakerTaggerProcessor that watches repeated non-owner embeddings, clusters them by mutual cosine >= threshold_match, and auto-enrolls a new 'guest_NN' speaker after `speaker_id_auto_enroll_after` matches; gated behind a new `speaker_id_auto_enroll_enabled` setting (default False). Non-owner speakers are still blocked from acting by the existing decider drop at line 524 — auto-enroll only gives strangers a stable identity label, not command authority.
scope_note: All changes remain flag-gated by settings.speaker_id_enabled (default False). Tests MUST mock src.speaker_id.embed at module boundary — no torch/speechbrain download. Flag-off golden fixture tests/fixtures/decider_prompt_flag_off.golden.txt is a hard gate: A1 touches the context builder, so the flag-off canary in tests/test_context.py AND the RT-005 import canary in tests/test_decider.py must continue to pass byte-identically. The 343 tests from the daemon-polish phase are the regression floor. Security invariant: auto-enrollment must NOT grant action authority — the decider's speaker_id != 'owner' drop at decider.py:524-526 remains the sole gate. Out of scope: multi-cluster candidate tracking (v1 assumes one stranger at a time), cross-session candidate persistence (in-memory only), rich drift visualizations (CLI text is enough).

stories.evidence: src/storage.py recent_transcripts now selects speaker_id and returns it in the row dicts. src/context.py _format_recent redacts non-owner rows (including speaker_id=None as fail-closed) to literal '[інший голос]' when settings.speaker_id_enabled is True; verbatim pass-through when flag is off. Added 1 test in test_storage.py (recent_transcripts_includes_speaker_id) and 3 tests in test_context.py (redacts_non_owner_when_flag_on, passthrough_when_flag_off, none_speaker_id_treated_as_non_owner). Flag-off golden fixture test_golden_string_flag_off_render byte-identical. RT-005 canary test_decider_import_does_not_break_flag_off_render byte-identical. Full suite: 347 passed (343 baseline + 4 new), zero regressions, ruff clean.
stories.rationale: Security: today when speaker_id_enabled, the decider's recent_transcripts block renders every row verbatim, including rows whose transcript.speaker_id is not 'owner'. A stranger can indirectly prompt-inject the decider by speaking near the mic. Redacting non-owner rows in the context builder closes the leak without changing the decider.py drop logic (which already skips non-owner utterances from becoming current-turn input).

stories.rationale: Ops surface: operators currently have no way to inspect or groom the gallery short of reading ~/.heare/speakers.json by hand. A `heare speakers` subcommand family lets them list enrolled speakers, inspect a single entry, remove a bad enrollment, and rename a label. Reuses the existing SpeakerGallery API and sanitize_label; no new storage.

stories.title: Drift audit — per-speaker cosine drift statistics
stories.evidence: src/speaker_gallery.py: new audit(speaker_id) method returning {ref_count, min/mean/max_cos_vs_centroid, mean_cos_vs_enrollment, enrollment_cos_floor_hit} with drift detection at AUTO_ENROLL_MIN_COS=0.55. src/main.py: _cmd_speakers_audit formats the report per speaker with OK/DRIFT status marker. Audit subparser takes optional speaker_id (defaults to all). tests/test_speaker_gallery.py: +4 audit tests (single_ref, multi_ref_healthy, detects_drift via direct gallery mutation bypassing anti-drift guard, missing_returns_none). tests/test_main_cli.py: +2 CLI tests (prints_ok_for_healthy, prints_drift_marker).
stories.rationale: Operators need a way to know when a speaker's gallery is drifting — the anti-drift guard in append_reference rejects new samples but doesn't tell anyone when the rejection rate spikes. A one-shot audit CLI computes per-ref cosine against centroid + enrollment ref for each speaker and flags any speaker whose mean cosine has fallen below a floor.
acceptanceCriteria: src/speaker_gallery.py adds `audit(speaker_id: str) -> dict | None` that returns None if speaker absent. Otherwise returns {ref_count, min_cos_vs_centroid, mean_cos_vs_centroid, max_cos_vs_centroid, mean_cos_vs_enrollment, enrollment_cos_floor_hit: bool} where enrollment_cos_floor_hit is True iff mean_cos_vs_enrollment < AUTO_ENROLL_MIN_COS (0.55)
src/main.py build_parser `speakers` subparser adds an `audit` sub-subcommand with optional positional `id` argument (if omitted, audit all speakers)

src/main.py `_cmd_speakers_audit(args)` loads the gallery, calls audit() per speaker, and prints a human-readable report per speaker: `<id> refs=<n> centroid[min=.. mean=.. max=..] enrollment[mean=..] <OK or DRIFT>`
The audit function uses numpy vector ops (dot product + norm) consistent with existing identify()/get_centroid() patterns; no new ML code

stories.title: Auto-enrollment of repeated non-owner voices (flag-gated, default off)
stories.evidence: src/config.py: new speaker_id_auto_enroll_enabled=False default. src/speaker_gallery.py: enroll_guest(v, max_guests=99) picks next unused guest_NN id, persists with enrollment metadata, hard-caps at 99 to protect against a noisy environment (returns empty string + logs WARNING on overflow). src/speaker_processor.py: SpeakerTaggerProcessor gains _stranger_candidates deque (maxlen=10), cleared on BotStartedSpeakingFrame so TTS echo never poisons the cluster. New _maybe_auto_enroll helper computes cosine of the new embedding against each prior candidate; if (matches+1) >= settings.speaker_id_auto_enroll_after (default 3), calls gallery.enroll_guest and clears the buffer on success. Auto-enroll is only invoked from the non-owner branch on non-short turns when the feature flag is on. tests/test_speaker_gallery.py: +3 enroll_guest tests. tests/test_speaker_processor.py: +5 tests (disabled_by_default, triggers_after_threshold, ignores_dissimilar_candidates via rotating-orthogonal embed monkeypatch, ignores_short_turns via 200ms audio, clears_buffer_after_success). Non-owner speakers are still blocked from command authority by the existing decider drop at decider.py:524 — auto-enroll only stabilizes the stranger label for context redaction and operator visibility.
stories.rationale: Final piece: a stranger who speaks 3+ times should get a persistent 'guest_NN' slot in the gallery so future turns identify them. Auto-enrollment does NOT grant action authority — the decider.py:524 drop keeps commands owner-only — it only stabilizes the non-owner label for context redaction and UI. Gated behind a NEW setting `speaker_id_auto_enroll_enabled` (default False) so existing tests and deployments are unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py Settings adds `speaker_id_auto_enroll_enabled: bool = False` (new field, default False — a separate master switch from speaker_id_enabled)

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor.__init__ adds `self._stranger_candidates: deque[np.ndarray] = deque(maxlen=10)` — in-memory rolling buffer of recent non-owner embeddings, never persisted

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: when slot has a valid embedding AND gallery.identify() returns sid=None AND slot.duration_ms >= settings.speaker_id_min_duration_ms AND settings.speaker_id_auto_enroll_enabled is True, append slot.embedding to self._stranger_candidates. Then count how many prior candidates in the deque have cosine >= settings.speaker_id_threshold_match against the new embedding. If (matches + 1) >= settings.speaker_id_auto_enroll_after, call gallery.enroll_guest(slot.embedding) and clear the buffer on success
